name: Ambush Commander
description: The leader of a patrol of rangers who hunts Iris and Alexio and scries their location in a golden goblet.

timeline.summary: Pursuers find the dead ambushers and the horse and track the Oracle and the Skyguard.
timeline.quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.

timeline.summary: The commander scries their location in a golden goblet and plans to ambush them in the cave with the help of a spider of the upper forest.
timeline.quote: We will ambush them in the cave.

timeline.summary: Ambushers attack the cave; Alexio finds the back entrance blocked by a spider web and is shot while clearing it.
timeline.quote: Another arrow twanged through the cavern, this time finding its mark.

pages_say.description: The leader of a patrol of rangers who hunts Iris and Alexio and scries their location in a golden goblet.
